excluded.reason: AWS Panorama ended support on May 31, 2026. AWS states that both the cloud service and connected Panorama devices cease functioning; no current relationship is selectable.

references.summary: AWS states that Panorama resources and the console are unavailable after May 31, 2026, and devices depend on the discontinued cloud service.

excluded.reason: Lookout for Vision was discontinued on October 31, 2025. Archived event/API documentation does not establish a current integration.

references.summary: AWS announces discontinuation on October 31, 2025 and describes exporting data to alternatives.

excluded.reason: Amazon Elastic Inference is no longer available. Its deprecated EC2 accelerator parameter cannot establish an active integration.

references.summary: The EC2 RunInstances reference marks ElasticInferenceAccelerator deprecated and states that Amazon Elastic Inference is no longer available.

excluded.reason: Activate is a startup credits and support program, not a deployable resource or data endpoint. Credit eligibility and human support are not runtime architecture connections.

references.summary: Activate credits offset eligible AWS service charges and are tracked through Activate and Billing consoles.

excluded.reason: Professional Services represents consulting engagements. The offering itself has no deployable resource endpoint to connect; infrastructure delivered by an engagement is modeled using its actual AWS services.

references.summary: AWS Professional Services provides consulting expertise and engagement delivery with AWS partners.

excluded.reason: Training and Certification represents education and credentials, not an architecture resource. Resources provisioned in a training lab are modeled as those resources.

references.summary: AWS Training and Certification provides cloud training and certification programs.

excluded.reason: Public re:Post is a human Q&A community, not a customer-deployed architecture resource. This exclusion does not apply to the separate re:Post Private service.

references.summary: AWS describes public re:Post as a community Q&A offering for customers, partners, and employees.

excluded.reason: AWS has ended support for IoT Events. Historical alarm and event examples do not establish a currently supported connection.

references.summary: The SiteWise alarm documentation explicitly states that AWS ended support for IoT Events.

excluded.reason: MediaStore was discontinued on November 13, 2025. AWS states that the service and all its capabilities are unavailable after that date.

references.summary: The AWS managed-services guide explicitly announces MediaStore discontinuation and loss of service capabilities on November 13, 2025.

excluded.reason: The Amazon Chime service ended support on February 20, 2026; its console and application resources are unavailable. The separate Chime SDK service is unaffected.

references.summary: AWS announces the Chime service shutdown on February 20, 2026 and explicitly excludes Chime SDK from the shutdown.

excluded.reason: AWS IQ is in full shutdown, effective May 20, 2026. The service is no longer available or supported.

references.summary: AWS General Reference lists IQ in full shutdown with an end-of-support date of May 20, 2026.

excluded.reason: Amazon WorkDocs shut down on April 25, 2025. Its service resources and API endpoints are no longer available.

references.summary: AWS General Reference lists WorkDocs in full shutdown, effective April 25, 2025; full shutdown means unavailable and unsupported in any capacity.

excluded.reason: The WorkDocs SDK has no active WorkDocs service endpoint: Amazon WorkDocs shut down on April 25, 2025. Archived SDK references do not establish a usable integration.

references.summary: AWS General Reference lists WorkDocs in full shutdown, including complete removal from the supported service portfolio.

excluded.reason: AWS SimSpace Weaver has ended support. Its console and resources are no longer available.

references.summary: The service-specific guide announces shutdown after May 20, 2026; the general shutdown table lists March 31, 2026. Both dates precede this review.

The English General Reference lists SimSpace Weaver in full shutdown, effective March 31, 2026. This differs from the translated service-guide date but establishes the same retired status by the review date.

excluded.reason: The Snowball/Snowball Edge workflow is excluded because AWS General Reference lists Snowball Edge in full shutdown, effective November 12, 2025. Earlier maintenance and existing-customer notices do not supersede that later lifecycle stage.

references.summary: The lifecycle table lists AWS Snowball Edge in full shutdown on November 12, 2025, alongside retired 80 TB and GPU configurations.
The maintenance table lists Snowball Edge Compute Optimized and Storage Optimized with an earlier October 7, 2025 announcement. The later full-shutdown entry governs this catalog.
The FAQ describes the Snowball service through Snowball Edge devices and carries a November 7, 2025 existing-customer restriction, earlier than the full-shutdown date.
